title: LF/LO Operator
summary:
Warehouse Operator – Eagle Farm - Immediate START

We are currently seeking a Warehouse Operator with a valid LO/LF Licence (High Reach/Order Picker) to join our team in Eagle Farm. Working through XMAS, Public Holidays off, $35 p/h + overtime available. Mon-Fri. 5am-1pm. 

Key Responsibilities:
Operate a Order Picker/High Reach safely and efficiently
Load, unload, scan, and assess materials and parcels
Accurately input data and complete basic reporting
Identify and communicate any errors or issues
Follow security protocols, including daily sign-in procedures
Maintain a clean and safe work environment
What We're Looking For:
Valid LO/LF Licence
Strong attention to detail and communication skills
Physically fit and able to lift parcels as required
Willingness to learn and take on new tasks
Ability to work with technology and input data accurately
Own reliable transport – must be able to travel to Eagle Farm early hours
PPE required: steel cap boots and hi-vis top
If you’re motivated, adaptable, and looking for hands-on work in a fast-paced environment, apply now and join our growing team!
